Name: Speed Master - Configurable Movement Speed Boost
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Speed Master

[/size][/b][/center][left]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][size=3][/size][/left]

[i]Take full control of your movement speed. Whether you want a constant boost or a realistic schedule where your energy changes throughout the day, this mod handles it all using a safe, native buff system.
[/i]
[b][size=4]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Safe Speed Boost:[/b] Uses the game's native Buff system. This means it stacks correctly with Coffee, Spicy Eel, and other food buffs without glitches.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Wide Range:[/b] Use a slider to adjust speed from +0 (Vanilla) up to +20 (Super Speed).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Performance Optimized:[/b] Checks logic efficiently to ensure zero lag.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Optional visual overlay to see your exact speed and active buffs in real-time.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41650/41650-1769376346-451121582.png[/img]﻿



[b][size=4]Two Game Modes[/size][/b]

You can toggle between these modes in the config menu:

[b]1. Constant Mode

[/b]
Set it and forget it. Choose a speed boost (e.g., +1 or +3) and your character will maintain that extra speed from the moment you wake up until you go to sleep.

[b]2. Adaptive Mode

[/b]
For a more immersive experience, this mode allows you to set different speeds for specific times of the day.

[list]
[*][b]6:00 AM - 9:00 AM:[/b] Set your morning pace.
[/list][list]
[*][b]9:00 AM - 12:00 PM:[/b] Mid-morning energy.
[/list][list]
[*][b]12:00 PM - 5:00 PM:[/b] Afternoon work speed.
[/list][list]
[*][b]5:00 PM - 12:00 AM:[/b] Evening winding down.
[/list][list]
[*][b]12:00 AM - 2:00 AM:[/b] Late night rush (useful for getting home before passing out!).
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41650/41650-1769376346-1560097424.png[/img]﻿


[b][size=4]Requirements & Installation
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[/list][list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Required to change settings).
[/list][list]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[/list][list]
[*]Run the game.
[/list][b][size=4]Configuration

[/size][/b]
You can configure the mod in-game using the Gear icon (Generic Mod Config Menu) at the bottom left of the title screen or the bottom of the in-game options menu.

[list]
[*][b]Adaptive Mode:[/b] Check this box to use the time-of-day schedule. Uncheck it to use Constant Speed.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Check this to see floating text above your head showing your current speed values.
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[/list][list]
[*]Works in Multiplayer (This is a client-side mod; each player can have their own speed settings).
[/list][list]
[*]Compatible with other movement mods (as long as they don't force speed to 0).
[/list]
